statement: Chopping to the Beat achievement: score 141 in chopping minigame, beating developer high score; rewards 25 gems and a 4-hour time candy.
Secret World 1 achievement Seriously Fast: score a point in the chopping minigame while the leaf is moving at hyper speed.
Each time the leaf hits a wall it increases in speed but only after a successful chop is made.
Spam click at the very start to bank a fresh easy amount of about seven chops before the leaf gets hard.
Aim to get at least one click per line hit each time the leaf bounces off the wall.
Green zone gives one point and yellow gives two; prioritize yellow but green is fine; the zone gets smaller and faster over time.
Prioritize yellows first; once you get close to 100-110 score stop prioritizing yellows and just go for greens.
The 141 achievement is the easy one; it just takes time and practice and a basic understanding of the minigame.
To set up Seriously Fast, get about four points, let the leaf bounce about 20 times off walls so its speed increases exponentially.
After the speed jumps, leave the game for 5 to 10 minutes so the leaf accumulates lightning speed.
Wait about 15 minutes before attempting; 10 minutes also works.
After waiting click the green to resume; the leaf should be going rapid which is hyper speed; hitting it is very RNG based.
Watch for a bold leaf protruding past the clone leaves; if you see fewer than five on screen at once, you probably won't hit it.
No real trick to unlocking this other than waiting 10 to 15 minutes and hoping for luck; it is completely RNG.
If you wait too long the leaf goes so fast you can't see it and is nowhere near the green line.
Ideally wait about 10 to 15 minutes so you can still locate where the bolded leaf is.
He hit it five times in a row on his first attempt for the video but says it took him many tries originally.
